reviews.title: Teen loves it!
reviews.comment: Great quality and picture. Teenager gamer loves it!
reviews.author: Dee

reviews.title: HDR in a budget
reviews.comment: Honestly, there are better monitors, if you want to spend twice as much. I can't notice an appreciable difference. The color settings with HDR were a little tricky but when everything clicked, it was perfect for 1440p gaming.
reviews.author: Joseph Leeman

reviews.title: Nice But No Speakers
reviews.comment: The display is very nice. Bright with excellent color resolution. The stand is adjustable with some tools. Only issue is that there are no speakers but, unfortunately, there is an audio out jack on the monitor and the monitor control menu has “audio” as an option. This would, of course, lead to the assumption that  speakers were present on the monitor. Very misleading.
reviews.author: Mike D.

reviews.title: Great worth for the price
reviews.comment:
Got 34 inch 2k height adjustable.
Works great for day to day works.
Not a gamer... using it for coding and other works.
Does not have speaker.
reviews.author: prak.rit

reviews.title: Dead pixel and wobbly.
reviews.comment: The monitor is a great size. Unfortunately, mine has issues: there is at least one dead pixel and the stand is pretty wobbly- it does not feel quality made. I returned mine and won’t be replacing it with the same brand.
reviews.author: Nikki
